# Nora

## Appearance

Nora is a resident of Andrews' Cove. She is characterized physically by her black hair and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)_

## History

Nora is one of the imaginative shore friends created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in his fantastical stories. Along with the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), she is featured in Paul's letter to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) describing fictional adventures like sailing into a moonglade and visiting the sunset. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) later clarifies in a postscript that Nora and the other shore friends are not real.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P10](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0010), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P14](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0014), +16 more_
